payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP with convex hull trick optimization: dp[i] = min_{j<i} (a[i] * b[j] + dp[j]), using decreasing slopes and increasing x.
payload.rationale: DP state is 1D array t[i]. Other subtypes (tree, 2D, interval, etc.) do not match; no explicit knapsack or counting. Optimization via convex hull trick is not a separate subtype.
